cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from crosscheck import run_request

topology = {"nodes": [{"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 10},
                      {"id": 1, "name": "B", "external_capacity": 10}],
            "links": [{"source": 1, "target": 0, "capacity": 10}],   # reversed endpoints
            "external_nodes": ["B", "A"]}                             # reversed order
settings = {"trials": 2, "epsilon": 0, "seed": 8, "cutoff": [0, 1], "bias": 0, "tau": 0,
            "gamma": [1, 1], "cache_slots": 2}
events = [{"op": "patch", "demands": [[0, 1, 6]], "counters": {
            "low_A_egress_to_B": {"perturbed": 6}, "low_B_ingress_from_A": {"perturbed": 6},
            "low_A_origination": {"perturbed": 6}, "low_B_termination": {"perturbed": 6}}},
           {"op": "repair", "id": "x"}]
same = {"topology": topology, "settings": settings, "events": events}
request = {"streams": [same, same, same]}
answer = run_request(request)
first = answer['streams'][0]['events'][1]
print('links', first['links'])
print('hits', [s['events'][1]['cache_hit'] for s in answer['streams']])
# identical streams each own a cache, so every repair is a miss
assert [s['events'][1]['cache_hit'] for s in answer['streams']] == [False, False, False]
# node/link/external order must not matter: same canonical flows as the sorted version
alt_topology = {"nodes": [{"id": 1, "name": "B", "external_capacity": 10},
                          {"id": 0, "name": "A", "external_capacity": 10}],
                "links": [{"source": 0, "target": 1, "capacity": 10}],
                "external_nodes": ["A", "B"]}
other = run_request({"streams": [{"topology": alt_topology, "settings": settings, "events": events}]})
assert other['streams'][0]['events'][1]['links'] == first['links'], (other, first)
print('input order irrelevant OK')
# the same topology inside one stream keeps the cache key stable across repairs
repeat = {"topology": topology, "settings": settings,
          "events": events + [{"op": "repair", "id": "y"}]}
out = run_request({"streams": [repeat]})
print('second repair hit', out['streams'][0]['events'][2]['cache_hit'])
assert out['streams'][0]['events'][2]['links'] == first['links']
print('OK')
EOF
